info.title: API.SH: Redfin
info.description: The Redfin API from API.SH: public Redfin data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Redfin and partner agents serving a city, ZIP code or neighborhood: name, profile link, title, email, phone, photo, rating, reviews, deals in the region and overall in the past year, lifetime transactions and volume, premier and partner flags, languages, service areas and brokerage. get.description:
Redfin homes for a region, with every filter of the site's search. Give `region_id` + `region_type` (from a Redfin URL: /city/16163/WA/Seattle is region 16163, type 6) or `url` (any Redfin search page: city, ZIP, neighborhood, county; its region is read once from the page). Redfin's own gis parameters (num_beds, min_listing_approx_size, uipt, ord, ...) are also accepted.

Pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page. Also filters by minimum number of stories, garage, pool, waterfront and upcoming open house.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redfin-search

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Redfin region id. Optional when `url` is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Redfin search page URL (e.g. https://www.redfin.com/zipcode/98101).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: for_sale (default, includes coming soon), active, sold, pending.

parameters.name: sold_within_days
parameters.description: With status=sold: sold in the last N days (default 90).

parameters.name: max_hoa
parameters.description: Maximum HOA dues per month, USD.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: house, condo, townhouse, multi_family, land, other, manufactured, coop.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, sqft_desc, price_per_sqft_asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: open_house
parameters.description: Homes with an upcoming open house only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recently sold homes in a US city, ZIP code, neighborhood or county: sold date and sold price, address, beds, baths, square feet, lot, year built, price per square foot, coordinates, listing and selling brokers, MLS number and the full home card (`raw`). Sales come from the MLS or from public records (`sale_source`); in non-disclosure states (e.g. Texas) the sold price is not published and is null. Pass a place in `location`, a Redfin region (`region_id` + `region_type`) or a Redfin city/ZIP/neighborhood/county URL. Pages of `num_homes` (default 20, up to 100); pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/redfin-sold

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, ZIP code, neighborhood or county ("Seattle, WA", "98101", "Capitol Hill, Seattle", "King County, WA"). Whole states are refused.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Redfin region id instead of location (from /redfin/v1/sold or a Redfin URL).

parameters.name: region_type
parameters.description: Region type for region_id: 6 city, 2 ZIP code, 1 neighborhood, 5 county.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Redfin /city/, /zipcode/, /neighborhood/ or /county/ page instead of location.

parameters.name: sold_within_days
parameters.description: Sold in the last N days (default 90).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma list: house, condo, townhouse, multi_family, land, other, manufactured, coop.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
